AUDIT: FAIL
Objective Understood: Reviewed worker task 'Fix 326b real no-op blocker with real implementation' (risk tier: tier1) by reading the actual diff, not a self-report.
Standards Reviewed: AGENTS.md Operating Rule 7c structured audit protocol; risk-tier.py's deterministic tier classification.
Scope Confirmed:  STATUS_REPORT.md | 217 ++++++++++++++++++++++++-------------------------------
 1 file changed, 95 insertions(+), 122 deletions(-)
Evidence Recorded: This diff rewrites STATUS_REPORT.md to a 326b-resolution narrative that is byte-for-byte identical to content already committed directly to master as commit 4eadc5a ('docs: real dedup finding for UMR-20260813-092654-326b (PR #141 already covers it, not re-implemented)') before this task's branch was created; the worker's worktree was based on a stale commit predating that landing, so this PR reproduces already-merged work rather than adding anything new, and merging it would either fail to apply cleanly against current master or needlessly re-churn already-settled history for zero net change. Issues found: Diff's new content matches current master HEAD (commit 4eadc5a) verbatim -- this is a stale duplicate, not new work; Diff's removed ('old') content reflects a pre-4eadc5a state of STATUS_REPORT.md, confirming the branch was cut before the equivalent fix already landed on master; No actual code changes in this diff (STATUS_REPORT.md only); the task title claims a 'real implementation' but the substance is a documentation-only conclusion that duplicates an already-merged conclusion; Recommend closing this task as already-resolved rather than merging or requesting rework; no follow-up code subtask needed since the underlying 326b scope is genuinely covered by PR #141 per the (already-merged) prior report
Severity Classified: medium
Verdict: fail
Corrective Action Owner: Worker to address the findings listed above and resubmit.
Re-Audit Scheduled: Required after corrective changes are pushed.
